d.d: simple past and past participle of dig (replacing earlier digged)
A mammary gland on a domestic mammal with more than two breasts, mostly used to refer to the nipples of non-ruminants and non-primates.
A plant-eating sirenian of the species Dugong dugon, found in tropical regions and having a fluked tail.
Any animal of the family Dugongidae, of which the monotypic genus Dugong is the only extant kind.
A canoe made from a hollowed-out log.
A pit used to catch and store rainwater or runoff.
A rough dwelling consisting of an excavation in the ground, typically roofed with turf or basic sheeting.
